extDescription.message: Translate and polish text with your own AI key: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or Google Gemini.

errNoText.message: Select or enter some text first.

errNoKey.message: No API key yet. Open the extension settings first.

popupPlaceholder.message: Type or paste text. Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to run.

popupNoKey.message: No API key yet. Click the settings icon at the top right to add an OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key.

optIntro.message: Pick an AI provider and enter your own API key. The key is stored only in this browser and is sent only to the provider you choose.

optBaseUrlPlaceholder.message: Leave empty to use the official endpoint

optBaseUrlHelp.message: For proxies and compatible APIs. The browser asks for access to that host when you save.

optPermDenied.message: Access to that endpoint was not granted.

optBadUrl.message: The custom endpoint is not a valid URL.

optUsage1.message: Click the Luna icon in the browser toolbar to open the popup (pin it from the puzzle-piece menu for one-click access).

optUsage2.message: Type or paste your text, pick Translate or Polish, then press the button.

optUsage3.message: Press Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to run without leaving the keyboard.

optPrivacyText.message: API keys and settings are stored only in this browser profile (chrome.storage.local), unencrypted, and are never synced or sent anywhere except to the AI provider you chose. Text you translate or polish is sent to that provider and nowhere else. There is no Luna server and no analytics.

optClearConfirm.message: Delete all API keys and settings stored by this extension? This cannot be undone.

optPromptTokens.message: Use {{target}} for the target language and {{other}} for the second language; both are filled in automatically.
